name: hmziq-brand
description: The hmziq brand, one kit that installs into every hmziq site and app: a framework-free core, a Svelte kit, an Astro kit and the React design lab they were worked out in. See docs/README.md.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hmziq/brand-core build && pnpm --filter svelte-app build && pnpm --filter astro-app build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @hmziq/brand-core build && tsc -b && pnpm --filter @hmziq/brand-astro typecheck && pnpm --filter astro-app typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm check:kit && pnpm check:motion && pnpm check:colors && pnpm check:contrast && pnpm check:brand-kit && pnpm check:assets && pnpm check:parity
